profile.name: Fazil Shaikh
profile.title: Full Stack Developer & Generative AI Engineer
profile.tagline: LLMs, LangChain and LangGraph, wired into products people actually use.
profile.summary: Full Stack Developer and Generative AI Engineer with 3.7+ years in travel, fintech, and e-commerce. Led a GenAI chatbot launch that grew guest self-service by 25%, and made a booking site 40% faster.
profile.bio:
I build the whole thing: the React front end people touch, the Node services behind it, and increasingly the LLM layer that sits in between.

Most of my work has lived in travel, fintech and e-commerce, where the brief is rarely "make it pretty" and usually "make it fast, make it correct, and ship it this sprint". At The Hosteller I led a LangChain and RAG booking chatbot that raised self-service bookings by 25% and cut support queries by 30%, on a platform serving 5,000+ daily users.

I care about the unglamorous parts: query plans, render strategy, API contracts that don't break clients, and interfaces that still work on a three-year-old Android phone.

experience.description: Own booking-platform and CMS work end to end, plus the GenAI layer on top of it.
achievements: Led development of a LangChain and RAG booking chatbot, raising self-service bookings by 25% while lowering support queries by 30%.
Engineered a booking platform and CMS (React.js, Node.js, GraphQL, MongoDB) serving 5,000+ daily users.
Reduced page load time by 40% and API response time by 30% through rendering and query optimization.
Partnered with payment and inventory providers to launch 15+ GraphQL integrations.
Coordinated 2-week Agile sprints with product, design, and operations teams.

experience.description: Client-facing delivery for a digital marketing and creative agency.
achievements: Directed 3 client website builds in under 3 months, including petsalley.co.in and barkatdryfruits.com.
Built mobile-first, cross-browser interfaces scoring 90+ on Google Lighthouse performance and accessibility.
Managed client communication from requirements gathering to handover, meeting every deadline.

experience.description: Fintech platform work, including compliance-sensitive modules for Shriram Finance.
achievements: Collaborated with the Shriram Finance team to implement compliant core modules for its website.
Owned an API Monitoring Portal tracking 50+ APIs, detecting incidents 40% sooner.
Created an AWS Cost Management module that helped the team find 15% in cloud savings.

experience.description: Component-library and responsive UI work across a growing product surface.
achievements: Developed 20+ responsive pages and reusable React.js components, so new pages shipped 30% faster.
Increased mobile engagement by 20% by fixing cross-device and cross-browser layout issues.
